FFMPEG AND OTHER THIRD-PARTY LIBRARIES

This installer bundles the Windows build of the Python package "av" (PyAV
18.1.0) and the FFmpeg 8.1.2 libraries that it uses (avcodec, avformat,
avfilter, avutil, avdevice, swscale, swresample). FFmpeg is a trademark of
Fabrice Bellard, originator of the FFmpeg project (https://ffmpeg.org).

These FFmpeg libraries were built with --enable-version3 and are linked with
the GPL-licensed H.264 and H.265 encoders x264 and x265 (GPL-2.0 or later), the
LGPL-licensed MP3 encoder LAME and libiconv, and other libraries (Opus, dav1d,
SVT-AV1, libvpx, libwebp, Intel oneVPL, OpenCORE AMR, zlib, and the MinGW
C/C++ runtime). Because of x264 and x265, the combined FFmpeg libraries are
distributed under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later. This is
compatible with OpenSeek's own licence, the GNU Affero General Public License
version 3 or later (see GPLv3 section 13 and AGPLv3 section 13). The libraries
are separate DLL files and are called by OpenSeek only through the PyAV
package.

This software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group
(parts of FFmpeg's libavcodec).

Each component keeps its own licence and copyright notices; the full texts are
in the "licenses" folder of the installation. No nonfree components are
included.

SOURCE CODE: the complete corresponding source of all these libraries
(original archives, patches, build scripts, checksums) is available as
additional assets of the release this installer came from:
    https://github.com/obadevyh/openseek/releases/tag/<RELEASE-TAG>
and at the upstream project sites listed in SOURCE-OFFER.txt. See SOURCE-OFFER.txt
for the written offer. Requests: https://github.com/obadevyh/openseek/issues

NO WARRANTY: this software is provided without warranty of any kind, to the
extent permitted by law. Some video and audio formats (for example H.264,
H.265/HEVC, AAC, MP3, AMR) may be covered by patents in some countries; the
licences above grant no patent rights for them beyond what each licence states.
